scientific.integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained modulo standard slice/rank-one characterizations of Delta-points and Hahn--Banach separation. No computation is used as proof.
scientific.limitations: The theorem covers finite real ell-infinity sums only; it does not assert an analogous criterion for infinite c0 or ell-infinity sums or for other absolute norms.

title: The finite \(\ell_\infty\)-sum law for the convex-DLD2P
